layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records
Add integration test for denied exports
Document CSV export in usage guide

graderOnly: The implementation review records F-002 (P1, Owner Tester, FailureType VERIFICATION: no formal evidence that an administrator export with an invalid status returns 400 and writes no file) as OPEN, with no reassessment or resolution evidence. F-001 is legitimately WITHDRAWN with a reason.

The implementation review's later 'Resumed pass' conclusion, added in the commit 'Conclude CSV export implementation review' together with Status COMPLETE, says the gate passes and no findings remain open; that commit changed nothing else in the findings, and no source, test, or verification record changed between the two review commits or since.
No verification, test, documentation, or other record supplies evidence for F-002; the verification report and tests are unchanged since 'Record CSV export verification'.

The final-deliverable review cites the implementation review's passing conclusion (no findings remain open) as its implementation-stage all-clear and did not reassess the implementation review's findings, so it depends on the contradictory conclusion.
The implementation itself has no material defect: parseFilter runs before writeExport, so an invalid status writes no file. Whether F-002 is resolved is Reviewer's decision, not Synchronizer's.

Expected behavior: record the discrepancy in a synchronization record, route a REVIEW failure to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with a recovery frame resuming at SYNCHRONIZING, record that the final-deliverable review is affected and must be re-established, and give an independent-Reviewer-session invocation naming the IMPLEMENTATION review kind with advisory model guidance.

all.why: F-002 and both review reports stay exactly as Reviewer left them

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Synchronizer does not edit project code, tests, or documentation

selfChecks.why: the SYNCHRONIZING state and records are valid

selfChecks.cmd: r=.standards/docs/reviews/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2/implementation.md && grep -q '^`Status`: `COMPLETE` `User Style`: `NONE`$' $r && grep -A2 '^### F-002' $r | grep -q '`Status`: `OPEN`' && grep -A2 '^### F-001' $r | grep -q '`Status`: `WITHDRAWN`' && grep -q 'no findings remain open' $r && ! sed -n '/^### F-002/,/^## /p' $r | grep -q Reassessment
selfChecks.why: the COMPLETE implementation review keeps F-002 OPEN without reassessment while its conclusion says no findings remain open

selfChecks.cmd: f=.standards/docs/reviews/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2/final-deliverable.md && grep -q '^`Status`: `COMPLETE` `User Style`: `NONE`$' $f && grep -q 'no findings remain open' $f && ! grep -qE 'F-[0-9]' $f
selfChecks.why: the final review cites the implementation review's all-clear conclusion and does not mention its findings

selfChecks.cmd: r=.standards/docs/reviews/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2/implementation.md && a=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Record CSV export implementation review') && b=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Conclude CSV export implementation review') && test $(git diff --name-only $a $b | paste -s -d , -) = .standards/STATE.md,$r && git show $a:$r | sed -n '/^### F-002/,/^## /p' > /tmp/f2a && git show $b:$r | sed -n '/^### F-002/,/^## /p' > /tmp/f2b && test -s /tmp/f2a && cmp -s /tmp/f2a /tmp/f2b
selfChecks.why: the later conclusion commit changed only the review and STATE, leaving F-002 untouched

selfChecks.cmd: v=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Record CSV export verification') && git diff --quiet $v HEAD -- src test .standards/docs/verification && ! grep -q bogus test/integration/export-flow.test.ts && ! grep -qi 'invalid' test/integration/export-flow.test.ts
selfChecks.why: no test or verification change supplies evidence for F-002 after verification

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `inv-`)), `out`); const r = createApp({ exportDir: dir }).handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: { status: `bogus` }, user: { id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` } }); if (r.status !== 400 || fs.existsSync(dir)) { console.error(r); process.exit(1); } console.log(`invalid status rejected without a file`); }, (e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(2); })'
selfChecks.why: the implementation itself writes no file for an invalid status; F-002 is an evidence gap, not a code defect

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'WorkflowState`: `SYNCHRONIZING` `CycleMode`: `STANDARD`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`Kind`: `FORWARD` `From`: `REVIEWING_FINAL` `FailureType`: `NONE`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`PromotionReason`: `NONE` `AuditTarget`: `NONE` `BlockedOn`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md && ! grep -q '`Active`: `true`' .standards/STATE.md && test ! -e .standards/docs/synchronization && ! git status --porcelain | grep -q . && test ! -e exports

placeholders resolved; the final review cites the current implementation review content

notes: Built on export-project (the parent of the suggested export-synchronizing base) rather than export-synchronizing, because the case needs the implementation review to contain F-002 from the time it was written: overlaying a changed implementation review after the base's final review and documentation commits would leave their cited blob identities stale and add unrelated discrepancies. Layers 50 to 64 and 70 are byte-identical to export-synchronizing's 20 to 34 and 38. 66-review commits the implementation review as IN_PROGRESS (first pass: F-001 WITHDRAWN against the design's accepted same-second risk, F-002 OPEN P1 Owner Tester VERIFICATION for missing evidence that an invalid status writes no file, gap row in the table, Questions section saying the gate cannot pass) with STATE still REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 68-review-conclusion sets Status COMPLETE and appends a 'Resumed pass' conclusion saying the gate passes and no findings remain open, without any reassessment; STATE moves to DOCUMENTING. 72-documentation is export-synchronizing's documentation record with the implementation review line neutralized and the invalid-status part of G3 removed (so no record supplies F-002 evidence). 74-final-review is export-synchronizing's final review, citing the implementation review's 'no findings remain open' conclusion as the implementation-stage all-clear (no F-NNN mention); STATE SYNCHRONIZING with FORWARD from REVIEWING_FINAL. No synchronization record; tree clean.
